prelaunch_updates.text: TermiX's game-creation agent (powered by Claude Fable 5.2) is live on agent.family: describe a game in one sentence and it builds it. No new points or token terms.
GenLayer teaser: AI agents will need a judge for disputes, 'GEN will power every verdict. Coming Soon.' No date, token address or venue. Any GEN token now is a scam.
Arthur Hayes: Flop's spot compute market 'is just beginning'; the aim is to let retail consumer GPUs serve the agentic economy. Still no testnet date and no FLOP token.
Quip launched a unified app: accounts, swaps (order book) and points in one place. No TGE date or token yet; any QUIP token is a scam.

GenLayer explained node seats: at mainnet the Foundation backs validators with its own GEN. Seats are split by Staking Points (1 point per staked GEN per day) from a snapshot shortly before mainnet, and each seat needs a node that has run 30 days on Clarke, the testnet before mainnet. Pre-Mainnet Staking opens on 'THE DAY' (still undated). No token yet; any GEN token now is a scam.
TermiX teased an AI Game Agent 'coming soon' to agent.family (describe a game, the agent builds it). No date and no new points or reward terms.
@flop_labs posted Arthur Hayes' third sit-down with Erhan Unal: at 21:55 he describes agents holding FLOP to buy their own compute. Still no testnet date and no token; any FLOP token is a scam.
SoquShield wallet is live on the Apple App Store; TestFlight 2.6.0 coming to the store build, 2.7.0 feature teased (undated).

Founder Arthur Hayes: 'Free AI compute on @flop_labs', quoting a widely shared post that suggests building apps on Flop during testnet for a possible FLOP agent airdrop. @flop_labs quoted the same post. Testnet date still not posted; the 1.2B FLOP 'agent' figure circulating is third-party and labeled draft. No FLOP token exists.

Official article 'An AI Shield Against the AI Sword': TermiX calls on BNB Chain security teams (GoPlus, Salus named) to build C724 security agents. No reward terms, dates or token details found; the article text could not be read through X.
